description: Measures finite reference-target coincidence counts and rates across logical analyzer states for one or more analyzer-equipped target links. network.json declares each channel as polarizer or PBS: complementary PBS outputs are acquired together, reducing physical settings without changing the reported logical states. An optional symmetrized PBS readout preserves opposite-port component evidence and the declared single-branch average or multibranch sum.
summary: Measure link coincidence tomography across logical analyzer states.

referenceLinkId.description: Reference link whose H detector defines the coincidence partner.

targetLinkIds.description: Analyzer-equipped target quantum-link identifiers measured at each state.

polarizationAnalyzerDeviceIds.description: Analyzer devices leased while their target channels are configured and scanned.

tomographyStates.description: Logical H/V/D/A/R/L projections to report. A PBS acquires complementary pairs from one physical H/D/R setting; a polarizer requires one setting per requested logical projection.

items.description: One analyzer state accepted by the polarization analyzer.

measurementDurationSec.description: Finite coincidence acquisition duration for each analyzer state, in seconds.

coincidenceWindowPs.description: AND coincidence window used for every analyzer state, in picoseconds.

settleSec.description: Non-blocking delay after each analyzer-state change and before its finite measurement window, in seconds. The default allows the polarization analyzer to settle physically.

clear.description: Whether every finite acquisition window starts from cleared measurements.

useCompensatedTomoStates.description: Whether named analyzer states are resolved from an installed or loaded compensation table instead of the factory tomography table.

dwdmChannelByLink.description: Optional per-target DWDM channel overrides for analyzer wavelength configuration.

defaultDwdmChannel.description: Optional fallback DWDM channel when a target link does not declare one in network.json.

finalTomographyState.description: Optional state applied to every target analyzer after the scan, including best-effort terminal cleanup after a failed or aborted scan.

pbsReadout.description: PBS target readout: simultaneous reads complementary ports together in three settings; symmetrized uses six settings. One branch averages same-projection opposite-port readings; a multibranch topology preserves the sum of selected components, even when only one branch is selected.

targetBranchMode.description: Selected target branch(es). positive/negative select respectively the lower/higher numbered physical detector in that branch; logical orientation still follows network H/V port bindings. All measured components remain available.

referenceDetectorChannel.description: Optional selected reference detector; must be a sink of referenceLinkId. Other reference outputs are preserved when scanning a single target output.

resourceDeviceIds.description: Acquisition lease union: TimeTagger and explicitly required health guards. An empty list preserves the existing unguarded child-owned TimeTagger behavior.

latchGuard.description: Explicit finite-window policy. The default preserves the existing unguarded scan; required needs network healthGuards and their exact acquisition lease union.

subtractBackground.description: Subtract a duration-scaled detector-pair background before combining physical components, clipping each component at zero.

backgroundObservation.description: Background countsByPair keyed referenceChannel&targetChannel and positive measurementDurationSec; required when subtractBackground is true.

link.characterization.observation.linkPo.description: Reference-target coincidence counts and rates indexed by target link and analyzer state, with resolved topology and acquisition provenance.
